notes: Variant WLC.JER.6.29.v005 is selected to the base reading over s003–s005 and is aligned as the projection carries it.
'go on' is treated as the ASV's distinct rendering of the infinitive absolute צָרוֹף (rule 56); the alternative folds it into the finite verb's phrase.
The fronted 'do' is the finite verb's own, since no interrogative morpheme stands in the clause (rule 17's first limit).
